sentences.spokenText: 夜市的手工面具很好看
sentences.imageNotes: 夜市裡有手工面具攤，主角小女孩和主角媽媽看著幾個手工面具，覺得很好看。攤販是清楚的夜市攤販角色，不能長得像主角媽媽或老師。面具和攤位不可有文字、數字、價格、品牌或標籤。
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L241-S01 lesson image for a Taiwan preschool Traditional Chinese character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. At a Taiwan night market handmade mask stall, the protagonist little girl and protagonist mother look at several beautiful handmade masks displayed at the center of the stall. A clearly distinct night-market vendor stands behind the stall, arranging the masks; the vendor must not resemble the protagonist mother or a teacher. The scene clearly communicates: handmade masks at a night market look very nice.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl follows L154/L162/L163 family continuity, with pink hair clip and child proportions. Protagonist mother follows L154/L162/L163 family continuity, warm family role and distinct from vendor/teacher. Night-market vendor is a separate adult stallholder role with different face shape, hairstyle, clothing, and posture. L058 images are illustration style anchors only, not character identity references.
Composition: center the masks, mother, little girl, and vendor with safe margins; make the masks large and phone-readable; keep all stalls and people within a square crop.
Style/medium: refined warm watercolor children's textbook illustration matching L058 style traits, soft transparent watercolor, delicate colored-pencil linework, warm night lighting, detailed but uncluttered.
Constraints: no written text, numbers, signs, price tags, labels, brand marks, logos, zhuyin, watermarks, readable marks, or signage anywhere.
